emotional_tone: Exclusive, sophisticated, mysterious, architectural, timeless, extremely premium.

rules: NO bright yellow gold or neon. Champagne/bronze only as subtle accent.
NO excessive gradients. Use solid colors. Subtle textures only (grain, noise, linen).
NO glassmorphism. Use solid panel transitions.
Navy and Ivory are dominant background colors. Transition between them using dark navy sweeping panels.
Headings (Cormorant Garamond): Use luxury serif, tight letter spacing, high-contrast, dramatic scaling (text-5xl to text-7xl+).
Body/Nav/Metadata (Outfit): Clean, modern, widely spaced if uppercase (tracking-[0.2em]), legible.
Hierarchy: Editorial style. Do not make everything bold. Rely on font-light or font-normal for large elegant serif.
typography.installation: Add Google Fonts link for 'Cormorant Garamond' and 'Outfit' in index.html.

components_and_layout.ui_primitives: Lucide React (icons), strict custom HTML/Tailwind for layout (avoid generic Shadcn cards, prioritize pure raw grid/flex).
rules: NO generic SaaS UI patterns. NO excessive rounded cards (use sharp edges or max 2px radius).
Generous whitespace. Think of paddings as py-24, py-32.
Navigation: Minimalist luxury nav. 'AUREXA' on left, links in center/left, 'ACCESS' on right. Full-screen mobile menu.
Must use Lenis for smooth momentum scrolling.
Signature Animations: Unveiling curtain panels, diagonal/vertical wipes, staggered opacity/translateY.
Use GSAP ScrollTrigger for pinned horizontal-scroll gallery.
Hover states: Image scale (1.03x), subtle champagne borders, custom circular 'VIEW' cursor.
Performant: animate ONLY transform, opacity, and clip-path.

sections_guide.name: 01 Hero
sections_guide.details: Full viewport. Staggered line-by-line typography mask reveal. Navy panels slide apart (curtain unveil) to reveal a central artwork piece. Champagne light sweep on load. CTAs: ENTER THE COLLECTION / REQUEST INVITATION.

sections_guide.name: 02 The Collection
sections_guide.details: Horizontal scroll (GSAP). Large editorial photography, 01/08 numbering. Categories listed gracefully. No conventional card grids.

sections_guide.name: 03 Featured Lots
sections_guide.details: 4-6 lots. Title SELECTED LOTS. Hover: image scales ~1.03, subtle champagne border. Use custom circular 'VIEW' cursor.

sections_guide.name: 04 Auction
sections_guide.details: Elegant grid/table for lot preview. Minimal countdown timer (AUREXA II — XX DAYS...).

sections_guide.name: 05 AUREXA I
sections_guide.details: Previous edition. Overlapping images, staggered sequential reveals, cinematic editorial gallery.

sections_guide.name: 06 AUREXA II
sections_guide.details: Large typography layout. Dramatic image reveal. CTA REQUEST INVITATION.

sections_guide.name: 07 The Experience
sections_guide.details: Four text-heavy editorial sections. Emphasize curation, rarity, provenance.

sections_guide.name: 08 Partners
sections_guide.details: Generous spacing. Tiered (Presenting, Luxury, Cultural). NO dense logo walls. Elegant staggered fade-ins.

sections_guide.name: 09 Journal
sections_guide.details: Editorial article grid. Large serif titles, clean layout.

sections_guide.name: 10 Access
sections_guide.details: Invitation-only gate. Form 1: Enter Invitation Code (demo mode). Form 2: Request Invitation. Minimal inputs (border-bottom only, no heavy boxes).

sections_guide.name: 11 Footer
sections_guide.details: Minimalist. 'AUREXA / THE ART OF THE EXCEPTIONAL'. Thin champagne line. Sophisticated final reveal.

universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: DO NOT use generic centered layouts or simplistic UI. Build a cinematic, high-end editorial experience.
ALL interactive elements (buttons, links, forms) MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='request-invite-btn').
Use framer-motion extensively but tastefully for scroll reveals, text masking, and image reveals.
Install and integrate @studio-freight/lenis for smooth scrolling.
Install gsap and @gsap/react for the pinned horizontal scroll section (02 THE COLLECTION).
Never use completely transparent backgrounds for overlapping text, but you can rely on the dark navy or ivory bases.
Limit component library usage; build custom HTML + Tailwind for complex editorial layouts to break the 'SaaS' mold.
DO NOT use 3D, WebGL, or Canvas. Only use 2D transitions (clip-path wipes, transform, opacity).
Ensure all text remains accessible and elegant. Keep leading-tight on big headings, and tracking-widest on uppercase small metadata.
Forms in the 'Access' section should use minimalist bottom borders (border-b border-champagne_accent) rather than full bordered boxes.
